$comment: Budgets of the deterministic performance design tests (test-support/perf-budget.ts). A budget may only be lowered (scripts/check-perf-budgets.mjs enforces it against the base branch); lowering one locks in a measured gain. Raising one needs a reason in the pull request.

core.dispatcher.backlog.claimsPer100Deli.description: Claims per 100 deliveries while a default dispatcher (concurrency 10, batch 10) drains a 1,000-delivery backlog; handlers take 1-5 ms, store calls 1 ms (fake timers).

core.dispatcher.backlog.missingClaimSize.description: How far the average non-empty claim of that drain falls short of the batch size (0 = every claim full).

core.dispatcher.backlog.completeManyCall.description: completeMany calls per 100 deliveries in the same drain.

core.dispatcher.hotKeys.claimsPer100Deli.description: Claims per 100 deliveries draining 10 hot keys x 50 events at default settings.

core.dispatcher.trickle.claimsPerDeliver.description: Claims per delivery when single events are published to an idle default dispatcher, one at a time.

core.dispatcher.idle.claimsPer10PollInte.description: Claims of an idle dispatcher during 10 poll intervals (1 s each, fake timers), start-up claim included.

postgres.claim.idleCold.statements.description: Round trips (a transaction counts BEGIN and COMMIT) of a claim on a store with nothing due and no lane held.

postgres.claim.idle.laneWrites.description: Lane rows an idle claim updates.

postgres.claim.idleWarm.statements.description: Round trips of a claim with nothing due while the worker still holds the idle lane of its last delivery.

postgres.claim.backlogCold.statements.description: Round trips of the first claim (limit 50) of a worker on a 1,000-delivery unkeyed backlog.

postgres.claim.backlogWarm.statements.description: Round trips of the second claim (limit 50) on that backlog.

postgres.claim.hotKeysWarm.statements.description: Round trips of a claim (limit 10) of the next deliveries of 10 hot keys x 100 events after the heads completed.

postgres.claim.hotKeysAllInFlight.statem.description: Round trips of a claim that finds every one of the 10 hot keys in flight.

postgres.claim.distinctKeysCold.statemen.description: Round trips of the first claim (limit 200) on 1,000 events with distinct keys.

postgres.publish.unkeyedSingle.statement.description: Round trips of publishing one fresh unkeyed event with one handler in its own transaction. 0.1.0 needed 4 (BEGIN, two inserts, COMMIT).

postgres.publish.keyedSingle.statements.description: Round trips of publishing one fresh keyed event in its own transaction.

postgres.publish.budgetedSingle.sqlState.description: SQL statements a bus.transaction publish of one event sends on a pool the application passed in: BEGIN with the transaction-scoped budget settings, the insert, COMMIT. The server also runs the foreign key check of the insert.

postgres.publish.ownedPoolBudgetedSingle.description: The same on a pool the store created, once the connection keeps the budget as a session setting: BEGIN, the insert, COMMIT, as 0.2.0 sent without a budget (4 in pg_stat_statements with the foreign key check).

postgres.publish.keyedBatch100.statement.description: Round trips of publishing 100 fresh keyed events (7 keys) in one call; must not grow with the batch.

postgres.publish.repeatedEventNewHandler.description: Round trips of publishing an existing event id again with one more handler.

postgres.complete.single.statements.description: Round trips of completeMany with one lease.

postgres.complete.batch50.statements.description: Round trips of completeMany with 50 leases.

postgres.tuples.deliveries.updatesPerDel.description: Delivery rows updated per delivery, publish to completion (claim batch 50).

postgres.tuples.events.updatesPerEvent.description: Event rows updated per event while dispatching.

postgres.tuples.lanes.nonHotUpdatesPerce.description: Share of lane row updates that are not heap-only (HOT).

postgres.tuples.lanes.updatesPerDelivery.description: Lane row updates per delivery when 500 deliveries are drained 50 at a time.

postgres.tuples.eventCompletions.updates.description: event_completions updates per event with one handler.
event_completions updates per event with five handlers whose completions arrive in groups of 3, 1 ms apart.

postgres.tuples.keySequences.nonHotUpdat.description: Share of key_sequences updates that are not HOT (200 keyed publishes over 20 keys).

postgres.wal.dispatchBatch10.bytesPerDel.description: WAL bytes per delivery for claim and completion only, batch 10 (no full-page writes).

postgres.wal.dispatchBatch200.bytesPerDe.description: WAL bytes per delivery for claim and completion only, batch 200.

postgres.wal.publish.bytesPerEvent.description: WAL bytes per event, published 10 per call.

postgres.explain.claimBacklogWarm.buffer.description: Shared buffers of every statement of a warm claim (limit 50) over a 50,000-delivery backlog (1,000 keys).

postgres.explain.claimBacklogWarm.largeT.description: Sequential scans of deliveries or events in that claim.

postgres.explain.complete50.buffers.description: Shared buffers of completing 50 leases over the 50,000-delivery backlog.

postgres.explain.complete50.largeTableSe.description: Sequential scans of deliveries or events in that completion.

postgres.explain.extendLease.buffers.description: Shared buffers of one lease renewal.

postgres.explain.extendLease.largeTableS.description: Sequential scans of deliveries or events in a renewal.

postgres.explain.publishKeyedSingle.buff.description: Shared buffers of publishing one keyed event over the 50,000-delivery backlog.

postgres.explain.publishKeyedSingle.larg.description: Sequential scans of deliveries or events in that publish.

postgres.explain.claimIdle.buffers.description: Shared buffers of a claim on an idle store holding 5,000 deliveries due in an hour, after 5,000 completed ones were vacuumed away.

postgres.explain.claimIdle.largeTableSeq.description: Sequential scans of deliveries or events in that claim.

postgres.explain.claim.maximumEstimatedC.description: Highest planner cost estimate of a claim statement with 8 handlers, on 50,000 unkeyed deliveries (cold and warm) and on 20,000 deliveries of 10 hot keys whose heads are in flight. A statement above jit_above_cost (100,000 by default) is JIT-compiled on every call, which took about 100 ms.

postgres.explain.claimHotKeysAllInFlight.description: Shared buffers of a claim that finds all 10 hot keys (1,000 events) in flight.
Sequential scans of deliveries or events in that claim.

postgres.latency.defaults.p95Ms.description: p95 from a publishing process's commit to handler start in another process with default dispatcher settings (poll 1 s), 30 spaced events, the listening connection killed halfway.

postgres.latency.defaults.maxMs.description: Maximum of that latency; must stay below one poll interval plus a margin even without notifications.

mongodb.claim.idleCold.commands.description: Commands of a claim on a store with nothing due and no lane held.

mongodb.claim.backlogCold.commands.description: Commands of the first claim (limit 50) on a 1,000-delivery backlog.

mongodb.claim.backlogWarm.commands.description: Commands of the next claim (limit 50) on that backlog after the first batch completed.

mongodb.claim.hotKeysWarm.commands.description: Commands of a claim of the next deliveries of 10 hot keys x 100 events.

mongodb.claim.hotKeysAllInFlight.command.description: Commands of a claim that finds all 10 hot keys in flight.

mongodb.publish.single.commands.description: Commands (commit included) of publishing one event in its own transaction.

mongodb.publish.batch100.commands.description: Commands of publishing 100 events in one call; must not grow with the batch.

mongodb.complete.single.commands.description: Commands of completeMany with one lease.

mongodb.explain.claimCandidates.excessDo.description: Documents a claim's candidate query examines beyond twice what it returns (20,000 deliveries).

mongodb.explain.claimCandidates.collecti.description: Collection scans among a claim's candidate queries.

mongodb.oplog.dispatch.entriesPerDeliver.description: Oplog operations on the store's database per delivery for claim and completion (batch 50).

mongodb.oplog.dispatch.bytesPerDelivery.description: Oplog bytes per delivery for claim and completion (batch 50).

mongodb.schema.deliveryIndexes.description: Indexes on the deliveries collection, _id included.

mongodb.schema.deliveryIndexesWithoutPar.description: Indexes on deliveries without a partial filter: every insert and delete pays for them.

mongodb.latency.defaults.p95Ms.description: p95 from a publishing process's commit to handler start in another process with default dispatcher settings (poll 1 s), 30 spaced events.

mongodb.latency.defaults.maxMs.description: Maximum of that latency; must stay below one poll interval plus a margin.

mongodb.oplog.publish.entriesPerEvent.description: Oplog operations per published event (1,000 events, half keyed over 50 keys, 10 per call, one handler).

mongodb.oplog.publish.bytesPerEvent.description: Oplog bytes per published event (1,000 events with UUID-length ids, half keyed over 50 keys, 10 per call, one handler). 0.1.0 wrote 954 with the same test.

postgres.explain.claimBacklogWarm.extraB.description: How many more buffers that claim reads at 50,000 pending deliveries than at 5,000: a claim must not pay for the depth of the queue.

postgres.publish.unkeyedSingle.parsedSta.description: Statements the server parses and plans from their text for a publish of one fresh unkeyed event in its own transaction, once the connection has run a publish before (BEGIN and COMMIT not counted). 0.1.0 sent 2 unprepared statements per publish.

postgres.publish.keyedSingle.parsedState.description: The same for one fresh keyed event.

postgres.dispatch.parsedStatementsPerBat.description: Statements the server parses and plans from their text for a warm claim of 10 and the completion of what it claimed.

postgres.wal.publishSingle.bytesPerEvent.description: WAL bytes per event when each of 200 events is published alone in its own transaction (one handler, unkeyed; no full-page writes). With the benchmark's event (publish P=1 batch=1) 0.1.0 writes 1,740 bytes per event and this release 1,475 (docs/performance/publish-path.md).

postgres.explain.generic.largeTableSeque.description: Sequential scans of deliveries or events in the forced generic plans of a warm claim, a takeover claim, completing 50, a renewal and a keyed and an unkeyed publish over 50,000 deliveries.

postgres.explain.generic.maximumEstimate.description: Highest planner cost estimate of those generic plans (measured 10,608); jit_above_cost is 100,000 by default, and claims are held to the same 25,000 as postgres.explain.claim.maximumEstimatedCost.
